integrity.verification: finite exact-rational Gram-matrix checks plus explicit analytic argument

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the real L2-orthogonal affine projection on the union of singleton and pair Boolean layers with strictly positive exchangeable mass.
It does not optimize arbitrary nonexchangeable atomic weights, higher-degree projections, or alternative nonorthogonal projections.
Finite exact arithmetic checks supplement, rather than replace, the universal analytic proof.
Priority against unlocated incidence-design or least-squares literature is a residual uncertainty.
title: Optimal endpoint stability of affine least squares on the first two Boolean layers
